hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a symmetric, sign-independent effect of x4: large |x4| raises the target and small |x4| lowers it, consistent with a quadratic or saturating even function.
rationale: The four positive residuals (+0.29 to +0.30) all have |x4| >= 1.75 with mixed signs (+1.96, -1.75, +2.24, -1.92), while the six negative residuals all have |x4| <= 0.49. Targets for the large-|x4| rows sit at 0.74-0.85 versus 0.0-0.38 for small |x4|, while base predictions stay near 0.3-0.68, so the model fails to capture this even, apparently levelling-off dependence.
